entries.title: A card's thread shows the answer to your first reply
entries.body: When your first reply opened the thread beside a card with a long explanation, the thread could stop just above the bottom, so the answer that came next stayed out of sight behind a ↓ 1 new arrow. The thread now stays at the bottom until you scroll up yourself.
entries.noPicture: The fixed thread looks like any thread at its bottom; the fix only keeps it from stopping short as the first reply opens it.
